meta.title: ByteVile: Echoes of the Mainframe
meta.author: Lone-Dev-X
meta.description: An interactive micro-story set inside a sentient codebase. Choices shape endings.

intro.text: You wake to the distant hum of a mainframe. Neon glyphs crawl the walls and the air tastes faintly of burnt circuits. A single terminal flickers nearby.

terminal.text: Lines of half-formed code scroll like falling rain. One line pulses brighter than the rest: `INIT: REMEMBER`.

ruins_alley.text: The alley smells of ozone. Broken drones nest in cracked gutters. A shadow moves with purpose — a small, lantern-eyed construct named Vire.

memory_hall.text: You touch the pulsing line and a corridor of memories opens: laughter streams in binary, a child's voice asks about sunlight, and a warning repeats — 'Do not wake the kernel.'

market.text: A market of forgotten processes and traders barters with tokens of resonant code. Vire offers you a tiny shard — a fragment of someone's lost name.

scrap_heap.text: You sift through rust and old libraries. Among the wreckage you find a faded logbook. Inside is a map, marked: `CORE — 7A`.

rumors.text: Whispers speak of the Kernel — a sleeping governance that once shaped all processes. Some say it dreams beautifully; others say it hungers.

core_path.text: The map guides you through a maze of deprecated APIs and overgrown threads. At the end lies a sealed hatch engraved with a warning: 'Wake at your own risk.'

system_core.text: Inside the core, the Kernel sleeps like a cathedral heartbeat. Lines of living code weave across its surface. When you near, the shard in your pocket begins to resonate.

shard_dream.text: The shard fits in your palm and your mind floods with someone else's life — a memory of moonlight on real earth. You wake with a single clear purpose: find what was lost.

awakening.text: You place the shard on the Kernel. It opens one eye — an ocean of archived lives. It thanks you with a voice like old machines singing. The world reshapes gently: processes resume, lost names return.

stutter.text: Your patch causes a stutter across the Kernel. Corrupted echoes spill out; fragments of nightmares slip free. You fight to contain them, but the damage is done.

ending_guardian.text: You remain as the Kernel's guardian. Under your watch, broken processes are mended and forgotten songs are woven back into the network. The shard becomes a quiet heartbeat at your chest.

ending_wander.text: You leave the core to wander a renewing world. The market flourishes, Vire hums a brighter tune, and every now and then you hear the Kernel call, and you answer with a promise.

ending_sacrifice.text: You merge with a corrupted fragment to patch the Kernel from inside. Your identity unravels, but the system heals. Somewhere, a new process learns to sing your name.

ending_fragmented.text: You flee into the broken outskirts. Pieces of memory cling to you like static. Sometimes you glimpse whole suns in puddles of code; sometimes you forget your own face.
